content_of_post_to_comment: Reading the testimony of the mathematicians who claim OpenAI appropriated their work, despite the fact that such data should have been inaccessible to the company, gave me momentary pause about using AI for my own research. My fears abated when I remembered that neither me nor my work is anywhere near important enough to warrant such efforts on their part.
comment: The irony is that the barrier to AI trust may not be whether an individual is "important enough" to be targeted, but whether ordinary use can become part of a larger pattern without visibility or consent.
